vibe: International standard, architectural precision, highly professional, data-dense but readable.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for engineering.
rules: DO NOT use Inter for headings.
Always use tracking-tight on headings larger than 24px.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain an engineered, structural feel.
Data tables and financial numbers must use tabular-nums to align correctly.

colors.mode: Light theme default for professional B2B tools, with high-contrast components.
rules: Avoid pure black or pure white over large spans without structural borders.
No full-screen gradients. Use flat, solid colors for clarity.
Use Accent (Amber) strictly for warnings, 'ongoing' statuses, and attention hooks. Do not overuse.
The sidebar MUST use 'sidebar_bg' (Slate 900) to create a distinct, focused workspace area against the light app content.

visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum. No pill-shaped cards. Maintain a structured, architectural geometry.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards to lift them slightly off the #F8FAFC background. Use shadow-md for dropdowns/modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 (border-slate-200) on all cards, tables, and sections. This exposes the 'skeleton' of the application.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for data-heavy construction dashboards. Use solid, opaque surfaces to prevent data refraction and maintain contrast.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Use generous spacing (p-6) inside large cards, tighter spacing (p-3) in data tables.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and labels. Center align only empty states or highly visual isolated metrics.

component_treatments.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), rounded-lg. No heavy drop shadows.
component_treatments.buttons: Primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50.
component_treatments.tables: border-collapse. Header row must have border-b border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500. Rows have subtle border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50.
component_treatments.sidebar: Fixed left, bg-slate-900 text-slate-300. Active item: bg-slate-800 text-white border-l-2 border-blue-500.
component_treatments.tabs: Shadcn standard. DO NOT use fixed heights (h-9). Override with h-auto. Active tab gets bottom border or solid background toggle.
component_treatments.status_badges: Inline flex, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. e.g., Ongoing: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800. Completed: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800.
component_treatments.forms: Inputs use bg-white border-slate-200 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500.

rules: Micro-interactions only. No sweeping page transitions.
Hover states on all interactive elements (rows, buttons, links).
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), NEVER transition-all.

icons_and_assets.rationale: Phosphor provides highly professional, architectural, and legible icons perfect for dense enterprise tools.

login_background.description: High-resolution architectural blueprint. Use as the left split-screen background with a bg-slate-900/60 overlay to maintain the professional engineering vibe.

project_covers.description: Detailed Japanese construction site. Use in Project Planning / Project Details hero header.
Aerial view of an active construction site. Use as a placeholder for project imagery.

user_avatars.description: Young architect at desk. Use in Employee/User Management lists or Admin profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the previous dark zinc-950 and orange-500 styling. Apply the new light-theme High-Contrast Swiss layout.
Ensure the application container DOES NOT have text-align: center.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Tabs, DatePickers) but override their Vercel-look to match this architectural palette.
Implement Recharts for the 6 requested dashboard charts. Apply the defined chart_palette.
For the Field Ops one-tap attendance cards, ensure touch targets are massive (min-h-[80px]) and visually distinct.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast: Text must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards. Gray text must be dark enough (e.g., slate-500 or slate-600) on white backgrounds.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.alignment: Optical alignment over mathematical. Ensure numbers in financial tables are right-aligned.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.spacing: Maintain strong vertical rhythm. The gap between a section heading and its content must be less than the gap between sections.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.empty_states: Do not leave panels blank. Include a subtle Phosphor icon, a brief explanation, and a primary CTA to add data.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsiveness: The dashboard must fold elegantly. Sidebar collapses to hamburger on mobile. Data tables should allow horizontal scrolling on small screens.
